reviewerOrPass: Worker B, same AI, separate source-first pass
independenceMethod: The same AI separately reopened the adopted programme regulations and exact annual Dutch catalogue records, recalculated the credit allocation, and compared the two specialisation entries and standard capstone to the revised UCR records and workbook.
findings: The 180 EC consists of 60 first-year credits, 45 later mandatory course credits, 15 for the project, 20 selected specialisation credits, 10 psychology elective credits and 30 open credits in this plan. The formal rules establish the distribution where catalogue grouping combines elective categories. Both selected specialisations require all first-year credits. The Dutch capstone additionally requires Multivariate Data Analysis and assesses written, oral and collaborative research work. The corrected UCR schedules meet prerequisites and offerings. The broad option develops substantive cross-domain psychology and research, the brain option integrates neurobiology, behavior and computation, and the organizational option integrates social and workplace psychology with leadership and consumer research. Econometrics adds quantitative design and interpretation but is not specialist psychometrics; clinical assessment coursework does not establish a professional qualification. All three retain meaningful disciplinary overlap and distinct coursework. The frozen reader record clearly separates optional independent research from the external capstone.
